WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_tallies
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.archstat as status,
    st.tally,
    CAST(st.tally AS NUMERIC) / CAST(t.total_count AS NUMERIC) as share,
    CAST(1 AS NUMERIC) / CAST(t.num_statuses AS NUMERIC) as avg_share
  FROM status_tallies st
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  status,
  tally,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;
